about: a small cooling fan's works, 0.17 m across, laid over the round middle of a tex_fan_grille face 0.2–0.3 m square — a dark well, five pitched grey blades on a hub that turn while the device runs, and a steel guard of two rings and two crossed bars over them. Origin at the fan's centre on its face, facing up; turned up (rotDeg x 90) it faces south.
